mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ctg_verify ( email, verify_code, is_verify, created_at, expired_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{verifyCode}, 0, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR), DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) )
mapper.select: SELECT verify_id AS verifyId, email, verify_code AS verifyCode, is_verify AS isVerify, created_at AS createdAt, expired_at AS expiredAt, verified_at AS verifiedAt FROM ctg_verify WHERE email = #{email} AND verify_code = #{verifyCode} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
